outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed in image and left_ego_image (frame 0). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, with acquisition visible in wrist_image around frames 73–80. It then pulls the upper drawer outward: image and left_ego_image show increasing extension and exposed drawer sides/interior at frames 91–110. The gripper releases and withdraws at frames 115–126 while the drawer remains open. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visibly established.
